Bare filename href (no URI scheme) renders as inline link, not autolink (#397)

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="foobar.png">foobar.png</a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
